findings.evidence: The learner-facing intake declares German-first English-second CEFR B2, but scope, sources, several requirements, acceptance criteria, and revision text lack complete English counterparts. IPC, Correlation ID, Idempotency Key, fail-closed, Session Context, Capability, and Cancellation Handle are not explained on first use or linked to the glossary.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: Every normative section has a complete German/English pair and first-use explanations or a precise bilingual glossary link, followed by a complete Single re-review.

findings.evidence: The intake mentions Security and text status parity but does not explicitly decide privacy, WCAG 2.2 AA, platform and cross-platform behaviour, or software supply-chain applicability. The process, persistence, routing, and command scope makes these applicability decisions material, and no measurable acceptance or evidence covers them.
findings.reevaluationTrigger: Security, privacy, accessibility, platform, and supply-chain applicability plus measurable positive and negative evidence are stated without changing IAD201-IAD203 or delivery authority, followed by a complete Single re-review.
